text: Closed before any candidate or comparator result was run. Frozen protocol-v2 preserves v1 unchanged and resolves all three execution defects: common court uses fixed frame zero for every estimator and scoring-only masks, native nifreeze retains its registered median leave-one-volume-out predictor, and every row separates allocated cores, requested workers, and effective workers. The candidate, AFNI, and MCFLIRT are registered effective-serial at the four-core ceiling; nifreeze/ANTs is registered for four workers; the one-core court is 1/1/1. The co-primary common timing endpoint now uses the observable process/container-launch-through-fsynced-canonical-poses boundary; internal stage splits are diagnostic. Protocol SHA-256 ebc2346097d2ad5e4ccc4457154bab09912e96fe2a9d8043e9cf06c3dc122f40.
